4.3.1. Disposal of persons arrested under local and special Laws by the police.
A total of 37,57,990 persons including those carried over from the previous year were under custody during 1975 out of which charge-sheets could be laid against 89.4 per cent while investigations remained pending in respect of 9.7 per cent cases. The highest percentage in respect of those in whose cases investigaion could not be completed was under the 'Explosive and Explosive Substances Act' (31.3 per cent) and the lowest under the 'Indian Railways Act' (1.2 per cent).
